issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation omits the phrase 'και βλεπε' (and I saw/looked) and replaces it with a summary 'Tôi nhìn xem' (I looked), but more importantly, it fails to capture the specific sequence of the Greek: 'εκουσα... λεγοντος' (heard... saying) followed by 'και ειδον και ιδου' (and I saw and behold). While 'thấy' covers 'ειδον', the repetitive emphasis of 'και βλεπε' (and I saw/looked) is lost.
The Vietnamese translation omits the word 'και' (and) between 'ειδον' and 'ιδου', which in Greek provides a specific rhythmic and emphatic transition ('and I saw and behold').
